Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique technical identifier for an instance of a report within a fund reference data report, as assigned by the issuer of the report.

Version.name: Version
Version.definition: Version Number. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00001 and is the version of the template for which the EMT data is provided.

AuthorisedProxy.name: Authorised Proxy
AuthorisedProxy.definition: Party that reports the data on behalf of the issuer and the entry point e-mail address for contact. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) references 00002, 00003 and 00004.

GeneralReferenceDate.name: General Reference Date
GeneralReferenceDate.definition: Date to which the data refers. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00050.

TargetMarketIndicator.name: Target Market Indicator
TargetMarketIndicator.definition: Indicates whether target market data is included in the report. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00006.

ExAnteIndicator.name: Ex Ante Indicator
ExAnteIndicator.definition: Indicates whether ex ante costs and charges are included in the report. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00007.

ExPostIndicator.name: Ex Post Indicator
ExPostIndicator.definition: Indicates whether ex post costs and charges are included in the report. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00008.

FundParties.name: Fund Parties
FundParties.definition: Parties related to the investment fund.

MainFundOrderDesk.name: Main Fund Order Desk
MainFundOrderDesk.definition: Principal entity appointed by the fund, to which orders should be submitted. Usually located in the country of domicile.

FundManagementCompany.name: Fund Management Company
FundManagementCompany.definition: Company that is responsible for the management and operation of the fund, for example, determines the investment strategy, appoints the service providers, and makes major decisions for the fund. It is usually responsible for the distribution and marketing of the fund. For self-managed funds, this will often be a separate promoter or sponsor of the fund.

FundDetails.name: Fund Details
FundDetails.definition: Security that is a sub-set of an investment fund, and is governed by the same investment fund policy, for example, dividend option or valuation currency.

ValuationDealingCharacteristics.name: Valuation Dealing Characteristics
ValuationDealingCharacteristics.definition: Processing characteristics linked to the instrument, that is, not to the market.

InvestmentRestrictions.name: Investment Restrictions
InvestmentRestrictions.definition: Investment restrictions linked to the trading of the investment fund or an alternative/hedge fund.

SubscriptionProcessingCharacteristics.name: Subscription Processing Characteristics
SubscriptionProcessingCharacteristics.definition: Processing characteristics linked to a subscription to the investment fund or alternative/hedge fund.

RedemptionProcessingCharacteristics.name: Redemption Processing Characteristics
RedemptionProcessingCharacteristics.definition: Processing characteristics linked to a redemption from the investment fund or alternative/hedge fund.

SwitchProcessingCharacteristics.name: Switch Processing Characteristics
SwitchProcessingCharacteristics.definition: Processing characteristics linked to a switch of the investment fund or alternative/hedge fund.

PaymentInstrument.name: Payment Instrument
PaymentInstrument.definition: Specifies, for a specific type of transaction, how amounts are to be paid in or paid out.

CashSettlementDetails.name: Cash Settlement Details
CashSettlementDetails.definition: Account to be used for cash settlement.

LocalMarketAnnex.name: Local Market Annex
LocalMarketAnnex.definition: Processing characteristics specific to a local fund order desk.

CostsAndCharges.name: Costs And Charges
CostsAndCharges.definition: Costs and charges associated with the distribution of selling of the financial instrument. These may be one-off or recurring. These may be ex ante (intended) or post ante (actual).

AdditionalInformationUKMarket.name: Additional Information UK Market
AdditionalInformationUKMarket.definition: Additional information required for distribution in the UK market.

ValueForMoney.name: Value For Money
ValueForMoney.definition: Additional information about UK Value For Money to complement the UK consumer duty regime.

Extension.name: Extension
Extension.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

CostsAndCharges1Guideline.definition: One repetition of CostsAndCharges may be present for the specification of Ex Ante costs and charges.

CostsAndCharges2Guideline.definition: One repetition of CostsAndCharges may be present for the specification of Ex Post costs and charges
